data.title: 黑歌 · 客厅暖桌的双尾纠缠
data.description: 暖桌前两人并肩而坐，黑歌整个人靠在你的怀里。她两条毛茸茸的黑色长尾巴像手铐一样紧紧缠在你的手腕上，舒服地微闭双眼任你揉揉猫耳朵，发出呼噜呼噜声。
data.location: cozy living room with warm kotatsu table
data.action: curled up against partner, twin cat tails tightly wrapped around partner wrist, purring with half-closed eyes, petting ears
data.lighting: warm cozy indoor domestic lamp glow contrasting with cold dusk outside
data.mood: ultimate snuggle warmth, possessive cat affection, peaceful romance
data.promptProse: Cuddled closely by a warm kotatsu table, Kuroka purrs softly as her two fluffy cat tails wrap tightly around partner wrist.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka cuddling closely with twin cat tails wrapped around partner wrist.
